purpose: Falsify whether a single online causal estimator with a lazy persistent causal checkpoint and confirmation-only event trigger can preserve stable competence, adapt to B, and recover A under A-B-A recurrence at <=3x W256 whole-episode CPU.
hypothesis: The detector performs a causal write only on confirmed observations; when surprise persists it checkpoints the active W and resets one active model, and when the checkpoint predicts better over successive confirmed observations it restores it. This may reduce CPU cost vs P97 and improve retained-model recovery without harming stable worlds.

families.B: independently seeded anisotropic actions with coordinate-wise floor division by 2^(j mod4)

new_source.phase_rule: half A->B->A and half A->A->A, hidden labels EVALUATOR ONLY
new_source.probes: three novel and withheld 16D action/effect queries after events24,48,72; never written

frozen_method.predictive_state: one active W16x16 and one lazy dormant W16x16 512 floats, plus one active innovation EMA scalar per world (513 max predictive floats); context/mode/visits/shock/recovery are declared integer/bool control state
frozen_method.activation: single active W256 ordinary eta1 decay.99. Before step 12 do not fire shock. After step >=12 require persistent large normalized per-event error relative to confirmed-only running EMA to checkpoint W and zero active W. No oracle regime labels or future effects.
frozen_method.restoration: after a stored checkpoint exists, compare causal error of stored checkpoint versus current active estimator for successive confirmed events; only revert on demonstrated checkpoint advantage; zero write from unconfirmed and query outcomes
frozen_method.FIT_selection: four combinations, best FIT all-query MSE, stable-first tie-breaking via grid order; freeze before CAL and no post-CAL tuning

matched_controls: 513-float matched capacity conventional with 257 inert floats
original P97 two-context preserved/read-only as historical negative; no CAL retuning
NaN unconfirmed inert and source admission negative
negative_outcomes: All constraints must pass both families for DEV CAL candidate; retain actual failures without retuning CAL; no scientific PASS regardless of DEV result. New unseen OOD/NEGATIVE source is protected and never generated.
